## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Reference the current epic/task.

## Validation

List exact commands and outcomes; distinguish deterministic checks from model evaluations.

## Review

- [ ] Tests and documentation match behavior; implementation status updated.
- [ ] Provenance and licensing recorded; no private content or secrets.
- [ ] Skills remain drafts until human review; compatibility claims have evidence.
- [ ] No contributed scripts execute; safety and external links reviewed.
